transcript:
Header:
Date: 2025-10-07
Start Time: 08:45 PT
Duration: 51 minutes
Attendees: Priya, Sofia, Evan, Ben, Ava, Marcus, Roberto

Summary (auto): quick campaign sync for Oct 21 webinar - focus on registration funnel, run-of-show, assets and promotional calendar. action items assigned.

Topics: registration page / form fields, email cadence, social amplification, partner co-host outreach, rehearsal, measurement/UTMs, budget for paid ads, speaker logistics

Transcript:
[00:00] Priya: ok good morning team, um, thanks for making time, let's kick off the webinar campaign sync for Oct twenty first, we've got about 50 minutes, uh, objective is to align on assets and timeline and make sure owners are clear.
[00:18] Evan: morning, quick note, target attendee number is 300 registrants with a 30% attend rate so we want about 90 live. that drives our ad spend plan.
[00:34] Ben: cool, platform wise are we locked into Zoom Webinar? I can book, also need producer for the run-of-show.
[00:42] Priya: i think so, zoom webinar is easiest. Ben can you confirm availability for 10-21 rehearsal and producer?
[00:49] Ben: yes, i'll tentatively book rehearsal for 10-20 and confirm producer by Friday.
[00:55] Sofia: notes on content — we should have 3 themes: intro to Redwood inference platform, case study (customer anonymized), q&a + product roadmap tease. Also want a CTA for sign-up to trial.
[01:12] Ava: sounds good. for the case study we need a 2-slide summary and 60-second highlights video, can someone own the video?
[01:20] Roberto: i can do the 60-sec cut if we get raw footage by 10-13, but we'll need script.
[01:27] Priya: ok roberto owns the video, sife? (sic) Sofia will draft script and key lines by 10-09.
[01:33] Sofia: yep i'll do that.
[01:36] Marcus: on tracking, please have UTMs: source=email / channel=social / campaign=oct_webinar and set up goal in GA and registration Zap into HubSpot. i can do the Zap but need landing page form fields mapped.
[01:50] Evan: landing page — we should capture role, company, use case, and consent for marketing. avoid extra fields or drop-offs. also include speaker bios and agenda.
[02:05] Priya: agreed. we also discussed paid budget — earmark $3k for LinkedIn and $1k for Twitter/X paid, mostly to drive top-of-funnel. thoughts?
[02:18] Ben: seems ok, let's run a small test for 5 days to tune creative.
[02:23] Evan: for registration messaging, we should test two subject lines and 2 landing page hero images — A/B test.
[02:31] Sofia: i'll prepare two hero images and two subject line options.
[02:35] Priya: partner outreach — we have one potential co-host, DataWorks Labs, they can amplify to their list, do we want to invite?
[02:43] Ava: yes reach out, but we need a co-marketing agreement and a joint promo plan. Priya can you draft intro?
[02:50] Priya: i'll draft intro email and share with legal for a short co-marketing addendum.
[02:56] Ben: quick ops question — any special compliance/privacy notes? like retention or sensitive content we should avoid?
[03:03] Marcus: nothing special, just standard consent checkbox + GDPR opt-in language for EU attendees. add KMS logs? (misheard) i mean KMS is not relevant here, sorry.
[03:13] Priya: hah, ok.
[03:15] Sofia: timeline recap: deck + run-of-show by 10-09, landing page live 10-10, promo starts 10-11, rehearsal 10-20, webinar 10-21.
[03:26] Evan: speakers — Priya will moderate, Ava will present roadmap, Marcus will handle case study with product inputs, and we have a customer speaker TBD.
[03:36] Ben: can we get copy for confirmation and reminder emails? we need 3 emails: confirmation, 24-hr reminder, 1-hr reminder and post-webinar thank you + recording.
[03:48] Sofia: yes i'll draft the sequence and share in the content doc.
[03:52] Priya: note on conversion metrics — target registration->attend conversion 30%, attend->trial 8-10%, but we'll optimize.
